review_description: We Highly recommended Sunworks for the excellent service and great quality equipment installed, by  a honest reputable company. Paul offers great advice and provides independent information to help you decide which way to go  All the trades people were very friendly and polite and kept us informed of everything going on. Out of the three companies we had for quotes Paul at Sunworks was the only one not to pressure us for a decision and provide simple honest guidance Thanks again for a smooth and professional installation.
I was very happy with all aspects of service from sales to installation and quality of products .

The sales process was very friendly, proficient and responsive. I asked a lot of questions which were fully answered and the materials supplied with the quotation were clear and well presented.The installation team were friendly, proficient and turned up exactly when they promised.

I did most of the research about solar and solar systems on the  solarquotes website. The companies I contacted didn't have as Finn Peacock recommended the Suneye device except TheSunworks in Buderim. This was very important as we thought our place was shaded in summer after about 3pm and in winter after 1pm. The system we have is a Solaredge P300 DC Optimiser with REC twin peaks 280 watt panels. Since the system was installed about 5 days ago it produced over 150 kWh.

Of the many Sunshine Coast (Qld) suppliers/installers contacted, the Sunworks Solar Pty Ltd (t/a The Sun Works Solar Centres) sales rep was the most professional, knowledgeable, and interested in the products, not in just making a sale and upselling or offering useless expensive add-ons. And the only one to actually go onto the roof to measure, rather than standing in the veggie patch gazing upwards. Result: REC panels over an SMA inverter pumping 20+ kWh/day.The installation team were experts. Each member knew what he was supposed to do and just got on with it.Paperwork clear and on time. Explanations and answers to neophyte questions concise and accurate.Wouldn't it be nice if all the businesses we had to deal with operated like this?
